domain help: Enter only the subdomain part (e.g., "your-store" for your-store.myshopify.com)
connection description: Enter your Shopify store domain below to connect and start managing your products with Product Genius.
connected description: Your Shopify store is successfully connected.
step 1: You'll be redirected to Shopify to authorize the connection
step 2: Grant permissions for product and order management
step 3: Return here to start importing and managing your products
refresh message: Please refresh the page to try again
disconnect description: Are you sure you want to disconnect your Shopify store? This will remove the integration and you'll need to reconnect to access your products.
disconnect warning: This action cannot be undone. All product mappings and sync settings will be lost.
import products description: Navigate to the Products page and use the 'Import to Shopify' button to sync your selected products with your Shopify store.
payment setup description: Ensure you have a valid payment card saved to automatically handle customer orders and invoicing.
order processing description: When customers place orders in your Shopify store, invoices will be automatically created and paid using your saved payment method, and products will be shipped directly to customers.
important note description: Always maintain a valid saved payment card. Orders will not be processed automatically until payment issues are resolved manually.
confirm connection description: You are about to connect to the following Shopify store. This will redirect you to Shopify for authorization.
